select A.BOOKSET_ID, A.TABLE_ID, A.TRADE_ID, A.BUSI_ID, A.HAPPEN_DATE, A.BOOK_DATE, A.SUBJECT_NO, A.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO, A.CD_FLAG, A.O_CCY, A.O_HAPPEN_AMT, A.OFFSET_FLAG, A.SEQNO,
BBB.ACC_QUA_FLAG,
A.HAPPEN_NUMBER, A.BOK_DETAIL_ID, B.F_TRADE_ID, C.TABLE_NAME, A.BOOK_ID, A.BOOK_TYPE, A.B_CCY, A.B_HAPPEN_AMT, A.BOOK_REMARK, A.ISEXE_ZERO_AMT,
bbb.SUBJECT_NAME, bsd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME,
( CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN A.SUBJECT_NO ELSE bbb.FSUBJECT_ID END ) AS fsubjectId, ( CASE WHEN A.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN #{bottomLevel} ELSE bbb.SUBJECT_LEVEL END ) AS subjectLevel
from BOK_BOOKDETAIL_ALL A left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL B on A.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID left join BOK_TABLELIST C ON A.TABLE_ID = C.TABLE_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bbb ON bbb.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND bbb.SUBJECT_NO = A.SUBJECT_NO
LEFT JOIN BOK_BUSS_DETSUB bsd ON bb.BOOKSET_ID = bsd.BOOKSET_ID AND A.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO = bsd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO
where A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.BOOK_TYPE != '03' AND A.BOOKSET_ID IN ( SELECT btodo.BOOKSET_ID FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO btodo WHERE btodo.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND btodo.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND btodo.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND btodo.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND btodo.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} ) order by A.BOOKSET_ID,A.HAPPEN_DATE,A.BUSI_ID,A.TRADE_ID
